---
title: "Proof-of-concept candidate prioritisation with biofilm-burden proxies"
format: html
editor: source
---

Author-approved interpretation of cells, protein and polysaccharides as SEPARATE
biofilm-burden proxies. No composite, no contact with original authors.
Observation model: released material R = detachment fraction e * underlying
component burden B. Therefore B1/B0 = (R1/R0)/(e1/e0). This is an imposed
measurement model, not a fitted detachment mechanism. Each component has its own
proxy; cell-equivalent, protein-associated and polysaccharide-associated burden
are not summed into total biomass. Efficiency ratios0.5-1.5 are illustrative
stress scenarios, not an estimated range; valid absolute fractions must satisfy
0<e0<=1 and0<e1<=1. At nonunit efficiency and zero RNA suppression, changes
describe the separately imposed efficiency scenario, not suppression alone.

Use all14 candidates and all suppression levels from the frozen model.
Coefficient uncertainty envelopes are propagated conditional on each fixed
efficiency ratio. They are not joint uncertainty or intervention prediction
intervals. Rank patterns are exploratory and do not establish phage infectivity.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
src<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/biofilm_MAG_suppression_2026-09-14-v1/tables/treatment_summary.tsv"
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before<-sha(src);x<-fread(src)
stopifnot(nrow(x)==14*3*11,all(x$change_pct> -100))
rho<-c(.5,.75,1,1.25,1.5)
d<-rbindlist(lapply(rho,function(e){
 z<-copy(x);z[,efficiency_ratio:=e]
 z[,burden_proxy_change_pct:=100*((1+change_pct/100)/e-1)]
 for(n in c("nominal_low","nominal_high","HC3_low","HC3_high"))
  set(z,j=paste0("burden_",n),value=100*((1+z[[n]]/100)/e-1))
 z
}))
x[,break_even_efficiency_ratio:=1+change_pct/100]
x[,max_efficiency_decrease_pct:=100*(1-break_even_efficiency_ratio)]
# Positive means the central projected proxy decrease survives an efficiency
# decrease smaller than this threshold. Negative means efficiency must increase.
stopifnot(max(abs(d[efficiency_ratio==1,burden_proxy_change_pct]-x$change_pct))<1e-9,
 all(d$burden_nominal_low<=d$burden_proxy_change_pct+1e-9),
 all(d$burden_nominal_high>=d$burden_proxy_change_pct-1e-9))
# Independent mass-balance test using a valid baseline efficiency0.4 for all rho.
test<-copy(d);test[,R0:=.4*100]
test[,R1:=R0*(1+change_pct/100)]
test[,B1:=R1/(.4*efficiency_ratio)]
stopifnot(max(abs((test$B1-100)-d$burden_proxy_change_pct))<1e-8)
for(p in c("tables","figures","source"))dir.create(file.path(out,p),recursive=TRUE)
fwrite(d,file.path(out,"tables/proxy_efficiency_scenarios.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(x,file.path(out,"tables/break_even_efficiency.tsv"),sep="\t")
show<-d[abs(suppression-.5)<1e-8]
show[,candidate:=paste(ifelse(is.na(genus)|genus=="","Unclassified",genus),sub("_MAGScoT_cleanbin_"," / ",MAG_ID),sep="\n")]
show[,outcome_label:=factor(outcome,levels=c("log10_cells","protein_ug_cm2","polysaccharide_ug_cm2"),
 labels=c("Cell-count proxy","Protein proxy","Polysaccharide proxy"))]
show[,efficiency:=factor(efficiency_ratio,levels=rho,labels=c("50%","75%","100%","125%","150%"))]
show[,fill_value:=pmax(-100,pmin(100,burden_proxy_change_pct))]
g<-ggplot(show,aes(efficiency,candidate,fill=fill_value))+
 geom_tile(colour="white",linewidth=.4)+
 geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%+.0f%%",burden_proxy_change_pct)),size=2.7)+
 facet_wrap(~outcome_label,nrow=1)+
 scale_fill_gradient2(low="#2166AC",mid="white",high="#B2182B",limits=c(-100,100),name="Proxy change (%)")+
 theme_minimal(base_size=10)+theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),legend.position="bottom")+
 labs(x="Detachment efficiency relative to baseline (100% = unchanged)",y=NULL,
  title="50% MAG transcription suppression: biofilm-burden proxy scenarios",
  subtitle="Blue = projected decrease; red = projected increase. Cells, protein and polysaccharides remain separate.",
  caption="Central model scenarios, not measured effects. Colour saturates at ±100%; labels retain values. Uncertainty in accompanying tables.")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/candidate_efficiency_sensitivity.png"),g,width=15,height=10,dpi=180,device=ragg::agg_png)
stopifnot(identical(before,sha(src)))
file.copy(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"),file.path(out,"source/biofilm_burden_proxy_sensitivity.qmd"))
fwrite(data.table(path=src,sha256=before),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("PASS:2310 scenarios; identity at efficiency ratio1; independent mass-balance calculation; interval ordering; source hash unchanged.",
 "Proof of concept: hypothetical effective RNA suppression, not phage dose.",
 "Proxy response model imposed; efficiency range illustrative, not estimated.",
 "All14candidates retained; no composite and no post hoc significance claim."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
```
